Owner-approved precision target: complete UTC calendar years1900 through2200,
with years1 through9999 retained as approximate exploration outside the target.
Qualification is pending. This plan is frozen before reference acquisition.

The model-argument sweep pads those calendar bounds by one day:
1899-Dec-31 00:00 through2201-Jan-02 00:00, JD Gregorian.
Primary instants: every30 days beginning at the padded start, not exceeding the
padded end. Additional instants: exact core start1900-Jan-01, exclusive core
end2201-Jan-01 and padded end, plus257 unique deterministic irregular instants.
Irregular generation: unsigned32-bit LCG, seed0x534F4C32,
state=(1664525*state+1013904223) mod2^32;
offset_seconds=floor(state*core_span_seconds/2^32), offset from core start;
JD values serialized to9 decimal places. Skip duplicates and regular-grid hits
until257 irregular instants are collected; add the three boundary probes.
No epoch is selected using native residuals or reference outcomes.

Reference endpoint: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api
Raw responses are retained unchanged with exact requests/source identities,
acquisition times, byte counts and SHA256. Bounded serial requests, at most2
attempts,30-second per-attempt deadline, at least0.3seconds between requests,
1MiB per response and64MiB total raw cap. TLIST batches contain at most64 epochs.

Geometric queries: ecliptic J2000/ICRF, NONE correction, AU-D, vector table1,
TDB model arguments. Target/origin pairs: Mercury199/10,Venus299/10,Earth399/10,
Mars-system4/10,Jupiter-system5/10,Saturn-system6/10,Uranus-system7/10,
Neptune-system8/10,Moon301/10 and geocentric Moon301/399.
Native TT is evaluated at the numerical TDB argument; TT-TDB is at most2ms in
this interval, below the model comparison budget. This is not UTC qualification.
Primary metric: full vector-norm residual divided by reference norm, times
206264.80624709636; maximum10 arcsecond-equivalent, unchanged from the existing
independent geometric-vector budget. Angular/radial diagnostics remain separate.

Apparent queries: Earth geocenter500@399, airless, Gregorian JD/TT, decimal degrees,
quantities2,20,30,45. Targets: Sun10,Moon301,Mercury199,Venus299,planetary systems
4/5/6/7/8. Primary Q2 great-circle budgets:10arcseconds Sun/planets,12 Moon.
Primary Q20 geocentric apparent-range budget:max(1km,10ppm*reference range).
Q30(TDB-UT) andQ45(apparent ICRF directions) are separate retained diagnostics.
All budgets are unchanged; every admitted numerical result is retained.

Native observation must use the actual Rust model source, including the existing
System ABI and the geocentric function used by Sky. A bounded isolated observer
may append a read-only entry point to an exact source copy; it must preserve all
original numerical functions/assets, bind their hashes, and demonstrate parity
with actual serialized snapshots at independent selected epochs. No duplicate
or refitted planetary/lunar algorithm may serve as the production observation.

All samples are validation data, not coefficient-fitting data. Any failed
admission or failed numerical check holds qualification. Data absence does not
qualify. No source-parity result becomes independent evidence by relabeling.
The full-range failing characterization remains retained. No continuous-error
proof, physical future UTC/EOP guarantee, observed-event, catalogue-star,
major-moon-knot, navigation or full-release qualification is inferred.
